Auditor recomputed: pairs10=3001130 (3001133-3 pairs involving 2,5), pairs3=3001131 (3001133-2 pairs involving 3); diagonal share 0.16947 vs 0.25; chi2_10=155166.05 (df15), chi2_3=47958.59 (df3); four T10 diagonals are the four smallest of 16; (7,7)=122881 most suppressed (0.6551x uniform), (9,1)=250160 most enhanced (1.3337x uniform). T3[1,2]=T3[2,1]=845128 is forced: filtered mod-3 residue sequence starts and ends in 2. HL collapsed-bin arithmetic recomputed from logged matrices: HL10 chi2=6365.57 vs uniform 10-bin 105744.04 (93.98% explained, reported ~94%); HL3 chi2=1815.72 vs 47958.59 (96.21% explained, reported ~96%); diagonal/symmetrised predictions (138333.6/408038.0 mod10; 673893.9/1653775.0 mod3) reproduced from li=3001562.70 via LOS Conjecture 1.1/Sec.2 closed forms. DRAFT honestly separates proved census from computed statistics and from the prior LOS conjecture (applied, not proved), notes chi2 dependence ignored and residual asymmetry as data. li differs from mpmath li by ~6 (2ppm), immaterial to percent-level residuals. No asymptotic theorem claimed.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp. LOS arXiv:1603.03720 establishes the bias question but tabulates different cutoffs: mod-3 pairs among first 1e6 primes (215873/283957/283957/216213), mod-10 16-pair table among first 1e8 primes (diagonals ~4.4-4.6M vs off-diagonals ~6-7.5M), Sec.5 power-of-ten tables at 1e9/1e10/1e11/1e12 (verified in full text). No x<=5e7 (pi~3M) T10/T3 census. Oliveira e Silva to 4e18 publishes only P(g), per-gap occurrence counts, top-50 gaps, HL constants for g<214: gap sizes with no residue labels, cannot mechanically imply residue-pair matrices without new residue-labeled enumeration. Prime Gap List Project curates only first-occurrence gaps/merits. pi tables contain no pair data. The 5e7 exact matrices and HL residuals at this cutoff are therefore new and not mechanically implied.

value.rationale: Rigorously established exact invariant of a natural object motivated before computation: consecutive-prime residue-pair transitions T10 (4x4) and T3 (2x2) at the standard 5e7 sieve-benchmark scale (~3M pairs), testing the recognized LOS (2016, PNAS) diagonal-suppression bias with quantified chi-square vs uniform and vs HL-corrected expectation plus named extremal pairs. Value not known or mechanically implied; future prime-distribution/k-tuple/HL-bias work can reuse the matrices as a citable 5e7 benchmark. Narrow single-cutoff datum is independently retrievable per standard (exact order/witness/datum rule); certification strengthens rather than substitutes for the pre-existing LOS motivation. Not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration.
